Before editing, read and obey `.ai-quality/agent-policy.md` and run `pwsh ./aq.ps1 status`. Require an adapter for every affected technology stack. In manual mode approvals belong to a human reviewer. In trusted mode the Agent may approve only through the workflow CLI after readiness checks pass, and must disclose that review was not independent. Only implement in an authorized state. Completion requires the complete multi-adapter Full gate, UI evidence when applicable, and a valid delivery report.
